concepts.name: 午后木屋
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, full-screen landscape iPad mini game-launcher frontend concept image, approximately 3:2 landscape. Flat screen artwork, edge-to-edge, NO iPad hardware frame, NO perspective device mockup, NO multi-panel presentation.
Theme and exact app title: “喵喵零和小鱼的小屋”. This is a personal cozy Slay the Spire 2 launcher, not a chat app or shopping app.
Input image role: the supplied sticker is CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY for 呆猫八条. Create a new complete illustration/interface, do not edit the sticker. Keep this character recognizable: pale gray head and back, white muzzle/chest/belly, darker gray tail/back accents, stout softly irregular bean-like body, short stubby legs, large simple head, little triangular cat ears, bold hand-drawn black outline, delightfully vacant deadpan expression, simple round or relaxed eyes. Ignore the reference sticker’s text and yellow background. Do not replace it with a generic photorealistic cat or a striped tiger cat.
Second main character is 小鱼: an original adorable anime baby shark, soft blue back, white belly and face underside, tiny fins, visible dorsal fin and tail, rounded snout, tiny friendly triangular teeth, blushing cheeks, bright uncomplicated eyes; this is a SHARK, not a dolphin or generic goldfish. The two characters feel like close friends living together, warm and gentle. Match their drawing weight and rendering to one cohesive world.
Functional UI: show a readable title, one dominant “开始游戏” button, secondary clearly labeled “存档管理”, “本地 MOD”, “联机小屋”, and a small settings gear. A subtle “杀戮尖塔 2” label may identify the game. Chinese text must be spelled exactly, cleanly typeset, large and readable. Avoid extra tiny fake text, metrics, account information, IP addresses, technical file paths, Steam logos or Workshop controls. Buttons are practical large touch targets with clear contrast; illustration stays separate from touch controls. Do not use random dashboards, generic SaaS cards, or massive empty stock gradients. Strong illustrated personality, uncluttered, usable as an actual launcher layout. No third main character, no humans, no watermark.
Direction A — AFTERNOON STORYBOOK COTTAGE. Refined hand-painted 2D picture-book illustration, gently textured gouache, warm pale wood and cream with soft leaf green and muted sky blue. Sunlit cozy little wood cabin, arched window overlooking a leafy garden, soft cushions, small shelf and a few plants. The cat and baby shark cuddle together on a rug near a low game table and a controller; both are clearly visible with appealing silhouettes. Spacious asymmetrical composition: the welcoming room and characters occupy roughly the left two-thirds, and a quiet cream-colored integrated panel on the right contains the main button and three tidy secondary action rows. The title sits elegantly across the upper-left on a calm wall area, with a small simple cat-paw-and-shark-fin emblem. Cozy soft afternoon window light, subtle illustrated shadows, high-end indie game art, not plastic 3D. The controls look like thoughtfully crafted native touch controls inset into the room’s stationery/wood language, not fantasy unreadable signposts.
